description:
AUDITED at origin/main `a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83` (2026-09-02).

## Status

LIVE, but the original samelambda3 witness is obsolete.

## Obsolete witness

The former `sl3.fz` reproducer now succeeds correctly after the fz-kdt.127 changes:

```text
interp: rc 0, 12 / 11.0
JIT:    rc 0, 12 / 11.0
```

Do not use sl3 as this ticket's red test.

## Live witness

Use fz-kdt.170's mailbox-driven dynamic map-capture reproducer. Its underlying dispatch bug routes an integer-capturing closure into the float-capture body.

Measured at a3a9761d1:

```text
interp: rc 0
        11.0
        12.0          WRONG: expected 12

JIT:    rc 134 after 11.0
        fz_ref_load_float:
        ExpectedTag { expected: ValueKind(14), found: ValueKind(13) }
```

The routing defect is owned by fz-kdt.170. This ticket owns the interpreter boundary behavior that hides it.

## Exact cause and scope

`AnyValue::as_float` in `src/ir_interp/value.rs` accepts both `Float(v)` and `Int(v)`, converting the latter with `v as f64`. `marshal_arg` in `src/ir_interp/extern_call.rs` uses that helper for `ExternTy::F64`, so a tagged interpreter Int crossing a declared F64 extern argument lane is silently converted into a plausible floating-point value.

Native does not perform that coercion at this seam: its typed float projection checks the runtime tag and aborts on Int.

`binop.rs` uses the same `as_float` helper for language-level numeric arithmetic and ordering. That mixed-number promotion is not an extern ABI projection and is outside this ticket. Do not make binop evaluation float-only.

## Required change

Make `ExternTy::F64` argument marshaling accept only `AnyValue::Float`. An `AnyValue::Int` reaching that lane must return an interpreter fault. Preserve Int acceptance for `ExternTy::I64` and preserve mixed Int/Float behavior in `binop.rs`.

Include enough call-site context in the diagnostic to identify the extern symbol and zero-based argument lane, for example:

```text
extern `fz_op_add_if` argument 1 (F64) must be Float, found Int
```

Do not fix or special-case fz-kdt.170's dispatch here.

## Acceptance

1. Add a focused red-first test proving an Int presented to an F64 extern marshal faults, while Float succeeds.
2. Run the fz-kdt.170 live reproducer on interp: it must fault after printing 11.0, and the diagnostic must name the extern symbol, argument lane, F64, and Int.
3. Preserve mixed integer/float arithmetic and comparison behavior in interpreter binop tests.
4. Preserve the corrected static sl3 behavior: interp and JIT both print exactly 12 / 11.0.
5. After fz-kdt.170 lands, its three-door fixture must print its Elixir oracle rather than reaching this tripwire.
6. Run focused interpreter/extern tests, `cargo fmt --check`, clippy with warnings denied, `cargo test --lib`, and the fixture matrix.
title: [BUG] Interpreter F64 extern marshal coerces Int instead of rejecting the wrong ABI lane
